name: PR Files changed tab renders Smart Diff: groups, collapsed lock file, badge reveal
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab (Smart Diff is now the default order) and confirm: the three role groups render (Core/Wiring/Boilerplate, uppercased by CSS text-transform — agent-browser matches innerText); package-lock.json is present but collapsed by design (a boilerplate file always starts collapsed, even with a finding — none here); the split banner is absent (the seeded PR's 285 changed lines / 9 files sit under both too_big thresholds); and clicking src/config.ts's finding badge reveals its CRITICAL line. Model-free: the flow never clicks the per-file ✨ Summarize pill, because deriving a real summary needs a model key and e2e runs without one (same rule 08-pr-intent.flow.json follows for 'Derive intent'). Collapse is asserted by an element COUNT, not just the header's presence — a header-only check would still pass if collapse were broken: exactly five of the nine seeded files render the shared 'no diff text' placeholder (the core/wiring files with no patch and no finding, all auto-expanded under 200 changed lines); package-lock.json and README.md (boilerplate, always collapsed) and src/config.ts / src/api/users.ts (real patch text, not the placeholder) are not among them. The two files with a seeded finding (src/config.ts CRITICAL, src/api/users.ts WARNING) both render a '1 findings' badge with identical text, so the config.ts badge is targeted by DOM position (nth, 0-based) rather than by text alone: sorted by finding count desc within its group, config.ts is the first file in the Wiring group, i.e. the second '1 findings' badge on the page (src/api/users.ts's is the first, as the first file of the Core group). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
switch to the Files changed tab
diff tab is active in the URL
Smart Diff (not the flat viewer) is the default order
the seeded lock file is present
the split banner is absent (too_big is false for the seeded PR)

cmd: text=No diff text available (binary or unfetched patch).
steps.label: package-lock.json's diff body is NOT rendered — only the 5 non-boilerplate, non-finding, patch-less files show this placeholder (package-lock.json and README.md, both boilerplate, stay collapsed; src/config.ts and src/api/users.ts have real patch text, not this placeholder)
click src/config.ts's finding badge (the second '1 findings' badge on the page, by DOM order)
src/config.ts's CRITICAL finding line is now visible
